data.why: A cookstove explained in a room cutaway: a pan on an open fire fills the room with smoke, and each fix (an iron firebox with a flue, a damper, an oven) causes the next problem. The camera opens close on the fire, then frames the stove with the gauge beside it, and shows the flue and the room only when the smoke and heat travel there. The finish adds the kettle, the stew pot and a chimney cap to the stove itself.

ideas.idea: a pan on an open fire is the simplest stove there is
the smoke has nowhere to go, so it rises and spreads over the ceiling
the smoke banks down the walls until the whole room is full of it
the air turns toxic: carbon monoxide passes 400 parts per million, enough for a headache within about two hours
box the fire in iron and run a pipe three feet above the roof, and the smoke leaves
the pipe pulls air in so hard that the fire roars and the gauge races into the red
a damper, a flap in the pipe, turns to slow the air and the gauge falls
the heat still races straight up the pipe and out of the roof
an oven beside the fire makes the hot gas loop around it before it leaves
the whole thing is a cookstove
the pipe on top is called a flue
air comes in at the front, feeds the fire, and the hot gas loops around the oven and out the flue
the oven bakes bread at about 230 degrees Celsius
a cuisinière is not only a stove: the stove book rises and is taken away
in French a cuisinière is also a woman who cooks
add a kettle, a pot of stew and a cap on the chimney to complete the cookstove
the room is calm, the fire burns in its box and the smoke goes out the flue

chain.shows: smoke rises from the open fire, then banks down the walls and fills the room
chain.stakes: the cook and everyone in the room breathe toxic air (carbon monoxide gauge to 400 ppm)

chain.shows: the pipe pulls air so hard that the fire roars and the heat gauge races into the red
chain.stakes: wood burns away in minutes and the iron gets dangerously hot

chain.shows: orange heat arrows race up the pipe and out of the roof
chain.stakes: the heat is wasted, so the room stays cold and the pot stays raw

surprises.claim: At 400 ppm of carbon monoxide, a person gets a headache within 1 to 2 hours, and it becomes life-threatening within about 3 hours
surprises.search: carbon monoxide 400 ppm headache 1-2 hours life threatening 3 hours

surprises.claim: A wood stove chimney must rise at least 3 feet above the roof where it passes through, and at least 2 feet higher than anything within 10 feet
surprises.search: NFPA 211 chimney 3 feet above roof 2 feet within 10 feet

surprises.claim: A wood cookstove oven bakes at about 230 °C (450 °F)
surprises.search: wood cookstove oven temperature 450 F 230 C baking

surprises.claim: In French, cuisinière means both a cooking stove and a woman who cooks (the feminine of cuisinier)
surprises.search: cuisinière meaning stove and female cook French
